title: TimeArch: A Multi-Agent Approach for Software Architecture Design
abstract: arXiv:2611.06921v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative AI is making software implementation faster, but not necessarily better architected. Most current GenAI coding workflows move directly from prompts to code, while the architectural reasoning that should connect requirements, quality attributes, stakeholders, design decisions, and implementation remains weakly supported. Architectural styles, system decomposition, tradeoff analysis, quality-attribute decisions, and stakeholder concerns are often left implicit or handled outside the AI-supported workflow. This creates a missing architectural layer between requirements and code, limiting traceability, validation, and governance in GenAI-enabled software development.   This paper presents TimeArch, a multi-agent approach that makes this architectural layer explicit. TimeArch structures software architecture design as a governed lifecycle rather than a one-shot generation task. It combines agent-based reasoning with retrieval-augme

translated_title: TimeArch：一种用于软件架构设计的多智能体方法
translated_abstract: 生成式AI正在让软件实现变得更快速，但不一定带来更好的架构。当前大多数GenAI编码工作流直接从提示词跳到代码，而本应连接需求、质量属性、利益相关者、设计决策与实现之间的架构推理仍然缺乏充分支持。架构风格、系统分解、权衡分析、质量属性决策以及利益相关者关注点往往被隐式处理，或在AI支持的工作流之外进行处理。这在需求与代码之间造成了一个缺失的架构层，限制了GenAI赋能软件开发中的可追溯性、验证与治理。本文提出了TimeArch，这是一种使该架构层显式化的多智能体方法。TimeArch将软件架构设计结构化为一个受治理的生命周期，而非一次性生成任务。它将基于智能体的推理与检索增强……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: TimeArch提出了一种多智能体方法，将软件架构设计结构化为受治理的生命周期，从而在GenAI编码工作流中显式填补需求与代码之间缺失的架构层。
en_tdlr: TimeArch is a multi-agent approach that structures software architecture design as a governed lifecycle, explicitly filling the missing architectural layer between requirements and code in GenAI-enabled coding workflows.
